HOME.TITLE: CNTA connecta
HOME.SLOGAN: Connecting mobility, services, artificial intelligence and blockchain.
HOME.ABOUT_TEXT_1: CNTA connecta is a token built on the Polygon network with the purpose of delivering real utility within an ecosystem of existing applications and services.
HOME.ABOUT_TEXT_2: Our goal is to connect urban mobility, service provision, AI-powered music content and blockchain technology all in one place.
HOME.FOUNDER_BIO_P1: I am a developer and entrepreneur passionate about blockchain technology and urban mobility. I built the entire CNTA ecosystem from scratch, personally taking care of every stage: from the smart contract on Polygon to the ZapMoto, ServLink and Connecta applications.
HOME.FOUNDER_BIO_P2: I believe in real utility instead of empty promises: every line of code and every integration is designed to connect people, services and opportunities in a transparent and sustainable way.
HOME.FOUNDER_PILLAR_1_DESC: Apps already live with real users (ZapMoto and ServLink) before any promises.
HOME.FOUNDER_PILLAR_2_DESC: Real revenue from services and part of the profits injected into token liquidity.
HOME.FOUNDER_PILLAR_3_DESC: Every important decision and goal progress is shared with the community.
HOME.HOWTOEARN_SUBTITLE: It's really simple: earn points and receive real tokens
HOME.HOWTOEARN_CALLOUT: CNTA points accumulated in the apps will be converted into real CNTA tokens.
HOME.HOWTOEARN_STEP_1_DESC: Start by installing ZapMoto or ServLink, the official apps of the CNTA ecosystem.
HOME.HOWTOEARN_STEP_2_DESC: Use the services, participate in actions and complete goals to accumulate CNTA points daily.
HOME.HOWTOEARN_STEP_3_DESC: Your accumulated points are automatically converted into real CNTA tokens in your wallet.
HOME.HOWTOEARN_STEP_4_DESC: To withdraw your CNTA tokens, the project goals must be completed. That is why we need a strong, engaged community growing together.
HOME.HOWTOEARN_CTA_DESC: Download our apps now and earn your first CNTA points.

WHITEPAPER.TITLE: Whitepaper
WHITEPAPER.OVERVIEW_P1: The project aims to build a digital ecosystem integrated by applications, music content, social media, business partners and a token developed on the Polygon network.
WHITEPAPER.OVERVIEW_P2: The proposal is to create real utility for the ecosystem through app growth, community expansion, content production, revenue generation and establishment of partnerships.
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_P1: The ecosystem will feature a goals program based on measurable growth and development indicators.
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_L2: Listeners and legitimate plays of music content
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_L3: Growth and engagement on social media
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_L4: Companies and partners integrated into the ecosystem
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_L5: Revenue generated by products and services
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_L6: Other relevant metrics for the sustainable development of the project
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_P3: Each goal will have previously defined criteria and a specific amount of tokens allocated as a reward.
WHITEPAPER.REWARDS_P4: The amount of tokens associated with a goal will only be unlocked when the published criteria are met. If a goal is not achieved, the tokens will remain in the rewards reserve.
WHITEPAPER.DISTRIBUTION_P1: After a goal is achieved, the unlocked tokens may be distributed among eligible participants according to a points and participation system.
WHITEPAPER.DISTRIBUTION_P2: The objective is to provide a distribution proportional to each participant's contribution to the ecosystem development, using public criteria and mechanisms designed to reduce fraudulent or artificial activities.
WHITEPAPER.DISTRIBUTION_P3: The Cnta points accumulated by users in the ecosystem applications (such as ZapMoto, ServLink and Connecta) will be converted into real CNTA tokens, according to the conversion rate and redemption periods previously established.
WHITEPAPER.DISTRIBUTION_P4: The points-to-tokens conversion table will be officially released before the redemption program begins, always respecting the available balance in the unlocked rewards reserves upon achievement of the project goals.
WHITEPAPER.SUST_P1: The project will seek to generate revenue through advertising, sponsorships, commercial partnerships, content monetization, technology services and other activities related to the ecosystem.
WHITEPAPER.SUST_P2: Revenue generation will not depend exclusively on token trading.
WHITEPAPER.SUST_P3: A liquidity policy may establish that a portion of the ecosystem's net profit be allocated to token liquidity. As an initial reference, up to 10% of the net profit may be allocated, provided the financial result is positive and operational, tax and legal obligations are duly considered.
WHITEPAPER.SUST_P4: Adding liquidity aims to strengthen the token market functioning and does not represent a guarantee of price appreciation, financial return or recovery of invested capital.
WHITEPAPER.TRANS_P1: Transparency will be one of the fundamental principles of the project.
WHITEPAPER.TRANS_P2: The official website may provide a public dashboard containing:
WHITEPAPER.TRANS_P3: Periodic reports will be published to present the project's evolution, allowing the community to track results, achieved goals, unachieved goals and use of reserves.
WHITEPAPER.PRINCIPLE_P1: The project seeks to establish a sustainable cycle:
WHITEPAPER.FINAL_P1: The token will be presented as part of the infrastructure and participation program of the ecosystem, with no promise of appreciation or guaranteed financial return.
WHITEPAPER.FINAL_P2: The definitive rules for tokenomics, distribution, rewards and liquidity must be published before official implementation and may be subject to legal and accounting review in accordance with applicable legislation.

HELP.FAQ_1_A: CNTA connecta is a token on the Polygon network that works as the currency for a complete app ecosystem, including urban mobility, services, AI music platform and much more.
HELP.FAQ_2_A: You can acquire CNTA through Uniswap on the Polygon network, using the address of the project's official smart contract.
HELP.FAQ_3_A: Currently, the ZapMoto and ServLink apps are already integrated. Soon, the Connecta app and other ecosystem services will also accept the token.
HELP.FAQ_4_Q: How does the rewards program work?
HELP.FAQ_4_A: The rewards program is based on measurable goals for ecosystem growth. Upon reaching each goal, tokens are unlocked and distributed to participants.
HELP.FAQ_5_Q: Does the token have real utility?
HELP.FAQ_5_A: Yes! CNTA can be used for cashback, payment for services in apps, participation in rewards and exclusive benefits throughout the entire ecosystem.
HELP.FAQ_6_A: CNTA is on the Polygon (MATIC) network, ensuring fast transactions with low fees for all users.
HELP.COMMUNITY_SUBTITLE: Join our official WhatsApp group and connect with other participants in the CNTA ecosystem. Receive news first hand, get your questions answered directly by the team and stay on top of all project updates.
HELP.CONTACT_SUBTITLE: Follow our social media and stay up to date with all the news!
